raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are re-delivered rows with record_version 2 alongside the original record_version 1 (4841 rows vs 4814 distinct txn_ids). The silver step does no deduplication, and it filters on status before any dedupe, so a superseded POSTED version could survive even when the latest version is REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED';"}}
